Q2: From the photos below, select the appropriate equipment for: 1 Sanding timber 2 Arc welding 3 Spraying glue 4 Spraying ‘two-pot’ paint Write the identifying number beneath the appropriate respiratory protection.

Activity: 1 Sanding timber – what is the appropriate respiratory protection?
questions.hint: Use the extraction system and wear a dust mask over the nose and mouth (page 35).
options: Air-fed breathing apparatus for two-pot paint
Dust mask / particulate respirator for sanding timber
Respirator with appropriate filters for spraying glue

rubric.check: Dust mask / particulate respirator for sanding timber

Q2: From the photos below, select the appropriate equipment for: 1 Sanding timber 2 Arc welding 3 Spraying glue 4 Spraying ‘two-pot’ paint Write the identifying number beneath the appropriate respiratory protection.

Activity: 3 Spraying glue – what is the appropriate respiratory protection?
questions.hint: Wear a respirator fitted with filters appropriate to the job. Dust masks are not suitable (page 37).
options: Respirator with appropriate filters for spraying glue
Air-fed breathing apparatus for two-pot paint
Dust mask / particulate respirator for sanding timber

rubric.check: Respirator with appropriate filters for spraying glue

questions.hint: You must wear a special breathing apparatus that has its own pure air supply (page 37).

Respirator with appropriate filters for spraying glue
Dust mask / particulate respirator for sanding timber
